title: Must AsmAI preserve compatibility with an existing Firstmate or OpenRig setup?
body: For example: must existing commands keep working, existing task history carry across, or existing agents/configuration run unchanged? This is separate from learning from their code. Compatibility can make reuse more valuable, but also constrain AsmAI’s design.
recommendation: Treat AsmAI as its own product with no v1 command, configuration, or task-history compatibility requirement. Use the references for useful ideas and consider concrete reuse on its merits. If you need a migration from your current Firstmate installation, name what must carry across.
options: Preserve or migrate my Firstmate setup — describe what matters
Preserve OpenRig compatibility — describe what matters
